data.sample_note: Sample files always use the fixed seed and are not exports of current uploads. Historical transactions also retain unit and currency snapshots.
data.upload_help: You may upload multiple CSV types at once. Records are merged by ID: new IDs are inserted, existing IDs are updated, and records not included in the upload remain unchanged. References are validated across the complete dataset; any error rejects the entire batch.
data.format_note: Format: UTF-8 (BOM allowed), Chinese column headers, dates as YYYY-MM-DD. Only actual payment date may be blank. Inventory may be zero; transaction quantity must be greater than zero; amounts and stock quantities cannot be negative.
data.confirm_simulated: I confirm that all uploaded content is team-generated synthetic data
data.commit_warning: Validated uploads are saved in one database transaction. Existing IDs are updated; records not included are retained. Existing calculation results are cleared after import.
data.import_failed: Validation failed. This batch was not applied; existing valid data is unchanged.
data.line_note: Row numbers are physical CSV line numbers (header is row 1). Cross-table reference errors identify the table containing the invalid reference.
data.import_saved: Validation passed and the database transaction was committed.
data.due_definition: Orders due by the analysis date: order date is on or before the analysis date and contractual due date is on or before it. On-time payment rate = orders paid by the analysis date on or before their due date ÷ orders due by the analysis date. Unpaid orders remain in the denominator; no rate is calculated when there are no due orders.
data.overdue_definition: Currently overdue and unpaid: due date is before the analysis date and the order remains unpaid as of that date. Historical late days = max(actual payment date − due date, 0) for paid orders, summed by customer; unpaid orders are excluded and shown separately in the detail.
data.payment_sample_note: Fewer than 10 due orders is marked “insufficient sample”; 10 is a demo threshold, not a claim of statistical reliability. Payments dated after the selected cutoff are treated as unpaid at that point in time.
data.payment_notice: These are descriptions of synthetic order payment records, not a character or creditworthiness judgement. They do not automatically determine credit, payment terms, or pay-after-delivery.
data.error.unknown_field: Unknown field. Use the sample CSV format.
data.error.column_count: Column count does not match the header

data.error.customer_date: Cannot be earlier than the customer start date

data.error.order_date: Cannot be earlier than the order date
data.error.empty_file: An empty table cannot be imported
data.error.csv_encoding: Could not read the CSV. Use UTF-8 encoding and check the file format.

finance.formula:
Cash advanced = max(base total cost − immediate-payment reference total × prepayment percentage, 0)
Cost of funds = cash advanced × annual cost-of-funds rate × balance term in days / 365
Deferred-payment reference price = (base unit cost + cost of funds / quantity) / (1 − target gross margin)
finance.result: Estimated cash advanced: {advance}; cost of funds: {cost}. Assumption: costs are advanced once at delivery, the prepayment offsets the immediate-payment reference total, and the balance is collected once at the contractual due date. Receivables are not treated as costs advanced.
expiry.rule_note: The 10% raw-material change threshold is a demo rule. Customer overdue history affects validity only when the explicit company review policy is enabled.
expiry.cost_stale: Cost data was updated {age} days ago, beyond the {threshold}-day threshold; consider limiting validity to 3 days
expiry.cost_current: Cost data was updated {age} days ago, within the {threshold}-day threshold
expiry.material_change: Raw-material prices changed by {change}%, reaching the {threshold}% threshold; consider limiting validity to 3 days
expiry.supplier_until: Supplier quote expires on {date}; the sales quote should not extend beyond that date
expiry.cost_missing: Cost update date is unavailable; using the company default validity
expiry.material_missing: Raw-material price change data is unavailable; using the default rule
expiry.supplier_missing: Supplier quote expiry is unavailable; using the company default rule
expiry.customer_policy: Customer history triggers the enabled manager review and 3-day maximum-validity policy
expiry.customer_review: Customer has overdue history; manager review is suggested. Current company policy does not allow it to affect validity.

history.quantile_note: Orders are equally weighted and percentiles use linear interpolation; quantity is not weighted. Historical references do not override the cost floor.

calc.formula:
Unit cost = material + labour + manufacturing overhead + (batch fixed fees + seller-paid batch logistics) / quantity
Target quote = unit cost / (1 - target gross margin)
Minimum permitted unit price = unit cost / (1 - minimum gross margin)
